## Test setup

## Test cases (all must FAIL until T2 implemented)
1. test_verifier_passes_all_artifacts_present: test.result, format.result, lint.result, classifier-dispatch.result, reviewer-record.result all in ARTIFACTS_DIR → exits 0
2. test_verifier_blocks_missing_test: test.result absent → exits 1
3. test_verifier_blocks_missing_lint: lint.result absent → exits 1
4. test_verifier_blocks_missing_reviewer_record: reviewer-record.result absent → exits 1
5. test_verifier_passes_tier_artifacts_ignored: reviewer-light.result present, reviewer-standard.result absent, reviewer-record.result present → exits 0 (tier-specific artifacts not in required list)
